description: Source code for the V4L2 H264 video decoder delegate in Chromium, implementing H264 acceleration using V4L2 API, including surface creation, frame submission, and picture output handling.

classes.name: V4L2H264Picture
classes.description: Represents an H264 picture with an associated V4L2 decode surface.

classes.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateH264
classes.description: Implements H264 decoding acceleration using V4L2 API, managing surface creation, frame submission, and output.

methods.name: CreateH264Picture
methods.description: Creates a new V4L2H264Picture associated with a decode surface.

methods.name: H264DPBToV4L2DPB
methods.description: Converts H264 Decoded Picture Buffer to V4L2 DPB entries.

methods.name: SubmitFrameMetadata
methods.description: Submits SPS, PPS, and DPB info to the decoder.

methods.name: SubmitSlice
methods.description: Submits a slice of H264 data for decoding.

methods.name: OutputPicture
methods.description: Outputs a decoded picture to the surface handler.

methods.name: H264PictureToV4L2DecodeSurface
methods.description: Converts an H264Picture to its associated V4L2 decode surface.
